title: Portal fd is converted to a raw fd before pw_context_connect_fd can fail
trigger: Start a Wayland screen share where pw_context_connect_fd returns null.
effect: fd.into_raw_fd() hands ownership away before the call, so on failure the descriptor is neither closed by PipeWire nor by Rust and leaks for the process lifetime.
fix: Keep the OwnedFd until the call succeeds (pass as_raw_fd/dup, forget it only on success).

title: The window monitor reports Ended without marking the stream stopped, unlike Windows
trigger: Share a window on macOS, then close that window
effect: Monitor pushes Ended and exits but StreamShared.stopped stays false, so frames keep flowing until the consumer stops and the SCStream delegate may push a second Ended
fix: Have the monitor end through a shared end() that swaps stopped once, as screen_win does.

title: An empty stream list overwrites the terminal Ended and Failed feeder states with NoStream
trigger: RTMP watch: a part reply returns GROUPCALL_INVALID (state Ended, Left outcome) while a getGroupCallStreams request is still in flight; that request then answers an empty list.
effect: on_streams_reply sets state=NoStream unconditionally, so stream_state() flips from Ended to NoStream and the watcher sees 'nobody is broadcasting' instead of the ended stream (live_feeds maps Ended to LiveEnd::Over). Same overwrite of Failed before the rejoin replaces the feeder.
fix: Make Ended and Failed terminal in one transition function (state.on_streams_empty() returns the same state for terminal variants), and drop streams_request when entering them.

title: If the reaper thread failed to spawn or died, hand_off runs the destroy inline on the caller (UI) thread
trigger: Thread creation fails at start (spawn_guarded error is ignored with let _) or the receiver is gone; then hang up or switch calls while tgcalls teardown is slow
effect: qc_p2p_destroy / qc_group_destroy wait on tgcalls with no time limit, so the UI thread freezes (the reaper exists to prevent exactly this)
fix: Make Reaper::start return Result and fail engine load, or leak/park the job instead of running it inline.

title: Late hook thread of a timed-out start overwrites the live hook's global CONTEXT
trigger: Start of hook A takes over 2 s (start returns Failed, failed_for set); the user presses 'Check again' and hook B starts and installs CONTEXT; thread A then runs run_hook and replaces CONTEXT with its own (active already false), unhooks and clear_context removes it.
effect: Hook B is Active but its on_key finds CONTEXT empty: push-to-talk never fires while Settings says it works.
fix: Key the context per hook (hook thread owns its context via a thread-local or a map by hook id) instead of one global slot.

title: X11 keycodes for the key are captured once at start
trigger: Start push-to-talk with key 't' on layout A, then switch keyboard layout/remap so 't' is on another keycode.
effect: The hook keeps listening to the old keycode, so the configured key no longer triggers push-to-talk until the call is rejoined or the key setting changes.
fix: Re-resolve keycodes on MappingNotify or when the layout changes, or restart the hook.

title: One generating bool covers two independent link requests
trigger: Admin clicks Share Invite Link; the listener request fails while the speaker request is in flight (or the speaker send fails in request_video_chat_share_links, which then forces generating=false); click again.
effect: generating is false though a request is still in flight, so plan() sends the speaker request again (wanted.speaker = speaker.is_none()); duplicate requests, and a late answer from the first. After a revoke reset (session_apply_ok.rs:385) in-flight old answers are also stored as the new links.
fix: Per-link Fetch<String> for listener and speaker; ready/generating derived; reset drops in-flight answers by generation.

title: SpeakerLevels keeps an ssrc forever when told_speaking is true and the driver stops accepting it
trigger: A participant is speaking (TDLib told speaking=true), then leaves the call so tell(ssrc) returns false.
effect: expire() retains the entry because told_speaking is true and speaking_changes never reports the stop; the entry lives until the levels are reset with the call (levels.rs:134). Small leak, no visible effect.
fix: Drop entries on participant removal, or make expire ignore told_speaking when tell() refuses the ssrc.

title: Failed screen-pause toggle is never retried and shows a generic voice chat error
trigger: Share a window in a group call, hide it (pause edge), toggleGroupCallScreenSharingIsPaused fails
effect: set_screen_paused already stored active.paused/call.screen_share_paused; the request uses the ToggleGroupCallVideo purpose so the error arm only sets group_call_error 'Voice chat request failed'; later pumps see no edge, so the server keeps showing the share unpaused
fix: Own purpose for the pause toggle whose error arm reverts the flag, or resend while server and local state differ.

title: send_call_log has no in-flight guard and does blocking file IO on the UI thread; stale log file left
trigger: Click 'upload call log' twice quickly
effect: Two sendCallLog requests are sent (log_sent only becomes true on ok) and call-<id>.log is written synchronously under exports each time
fix: CallLog stage enum (Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent, Failed) checked before the write.

title: AddPending error rolls pending stars back but not committed_stars after a commit already took the reaction
trigger: Tap Stars, window elapses and commit goes out, then the earlier addPending answers with an error
effect: pending is None so nothing is subtracted; committed_stars and the flying-stars effect stay as if sent
fix: Pending reaction as an enum of Adding/Held/Committing with each answer matched to its stage.

title: Undo drops the local pending Stars before removePendingLiveStoryReactions is sent
trigger: Tap Undo while the send fails
effect: Local pending reaction is gone but TDLib still holds the pending Stars and the toast says they were dropped
fix: Keep pending_reaction as Undoing(request) until ok.

title: Deleting live story comments removes them locally at once with no restore when deleteGroupCallMessages errors
trigger: Delete a comment (or all from a sender) and the request fails
effect: Comments vanish until the call is rejoined although they still exist
fix: Mark messages Deleting(request) and drop them on ok, restore on error.

title: Failed group camera/mute engine calls are re-issued on every poll for the life of the call
trigger: Engine set_group_camera or set_group_muted keeps failing (device unplugged)
effect: pump_connected_group_calls retries each poll; only transport_error is rate-limited, so the engine is hit and the UI woken repeatedly
fix: Record a Failed(wanted) value in the per-call state and retry only on a change of wanted or a device list change.

title: An unwanted Rejoin offer is dropped without attempt_unsent, leaving rejoin InFlight on a request that is no longer pending
trigger: Rejoin offer is waiting for the payload while left_group_call is set for it or chats_path_active turns false
effect: GroupCallRejoin stays InFlight; maybe_auto_rejoin never restarts it (rejoin_tracked returns the dead request id unless manual), only the manual Rejoin button recovers
fix: finish_offer's unwanted branch must call undo_offer for every OfferSend, or Rejoin::InFlight must be validated against requests.

title: An unwanted Screen offer leaves screen_share_pending true with no offer or request behind it
trigger: Screen share offer lands after the call stopped being joined or chats_path_active turned false
effect: UI shows share starting until the user presses the toggle again (the toggle's pending branch recovers)
fix: Same fix as the rejoin offer: undo_offer on every unwanted branch.

title: Start Streaming closes the RTMP box as soon as createVideoChat is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Press Start Streaming; TDLib rejects createVideoChat (no rights, flood)
effect: The box is gone with only an error toast; the URL/key just fetched are lost and the user starts over
fix: RtmpStart::Starting(request) closed on the ok answer, reopened with the error on failure.

title: no_chat holds one call id; a second call opened before its chat loads overwrites the first
trigger: Open two calls from links before their chats are known (call + live story)
effect: The first call is never moved to its chat key and its stream feeder never starts
fix: HashSet/Vec of call ids waiting for a chat.

title: Call log and diagnostics answers are applied to whichever summary is current, not the call that asked
trigger: Finish call A with need_log, start upload, end call B quickly before the answer
effect: SendCallLog ok sets log_sent=true (session_apply_ok.rs:523) and SendCallDebugInformation error sets the error on the new summary of call B; B's own upload prompt disappears or shows A's error. RequestPurpose has no call id
fix: Carry call_id in the purposes and apply only when summary.call_id matches.

title: join_as_requested is set before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants and never reset on error
trigger: Open an unjoined video chat while the join-as request fails
effect: maybe_fetch_join_as sets join_as_requested=true first (connect/group_calls/join.rs:223); on a send or server error it stays true, so the Join as picker is never offered for this tracked call
fix: join_as: Fetch<Vec<MessageSender>> reset to Idle on error (or Failed) per group_call_id.

title: failed_creates grows when no UI drains it (background account)
trigger: createVideoChat is refused on an account that is not on screen
effect: The request id stays in CallsState::failed_creates until the UI shows it; a switch back shows an old failure
fix: Drop on a timer or hold the failure in the create_join_as/start stage value

title: A terminal update of an untracked call replaces the pending end-screen summary
trigger: End a call and leave the rating/end card open; a missed call from someone else ends (terminal update, no active call).
effect: calls.summary is overwritten with Missed call, so the card of the call being rated and its log upload state are lost.
fix: Keep summaries as a queue or keyed by call id, and replace only for the same id.

title: The own-mute guard treats any participant's mute toggle in flight as the user's own
trigger: In a video chat as admin, mute another participant (ToggleGroupCallParticipantMute for the call is in flight), then unmute yourself elsewhere; an own-row update arrives.
effect: The own-row update is ignored while the other participant's request is in flight, so the mute button can show a stale state until the next update.
fix: Key the in-flight check by (call, participant) and compare against the own sender.

title: A one-shot cue cuts a ringing loop which the next tick restarts
trigger: While a second call rings in during a call (loop Incoming), toggle mute.
effect: play(Mute) clears looping/hold and stops the ring; the next sync (up to 1 s) restarts the ring from the start, so the cue is cut and the ring restarts out of phase.
fix: Let a cue play on top of the loop or resume the loop without resetting its phase.

title: A failed later page hides every loaded call and Retry restarts from page one
trigger: Open Calls, scroll so page 2 fails.
effect: calls_list shows only Couldn't load plus Retry although entries are loaded; Retry calls fetch_call_history, which clears the list and scroll position.
fix: Model the list as Fetch<Page> with a failed-next-page variant that keeps entries and retries the next offset.

title: card_window (where a failed start or the rating shows) is never reset except by answer_call
trigger: Press Call in chat window X, finish the call. Later answer an incoming call through the call window swap card, the lock card or a background ring (none reset card_window), then end it while X is still open.
effect: The failed-start card or the rating card of the incoming call appears over chat window X, not the main window.
fix: Make the card window part of the call (ActiveCall/CallSummary owner) or reset it when a call is tracked from any source.

title: Stream window is closed and marked user-closed before the PiP exists
trigger: Press PiP in the stream window when the PiP window fails to open (Q_MEDIA_PIP_FAILED path).
effect: open_stream_pip sets window_closed_by_user=Some(call_id), drops stream_join and overlay and removes the stream window synchronously; the deferred open then fails, so the call has no window until the user finds the call bar.
fix: Close the stream window from the open success arm (or restore window_closed_by_user on failure).

title: A failed PiP open clears whatever link is current
trigger: Open a live PiP for source X, then (same frame) another for Y; X's deferred open fails.
effect: The (_, None) arm sets group_call.live_pip=None without checking that the link still is X's pending one: Y's link is dropped and its window closes when it opens, with an error note for X.
fix: Handle the failure only when the pending link matches source (as the success arm does); otherwise ignore.

title: live_pip_source_alive ignores the link's account
trigger: Play a stream PiP on account A, switch to account B which is in a group call with the same call id (same voice chat joined by both accounts).
effect: check_live_pip only compares call_id with B's active_group_call, so the PiP of A's stream stays open for B; only Enlarge compares link.account.
fix: Compare link.account with the account on screen in check_live_pip or key the source by (AccountKey, call_id).

title: submit_call_rating discards the rating draft before the send succeeds
trigger: Fill stars, problems and a comment in the rating editor and press Submit while send_call_rating returns Err.
effect: rating_detail is take()n first; on Err only a note is set, the editor reverts to the bare star buttons and the typed comment and problems are gone.
fix: Take the draft only after the send is accepted, or put it back on Err.

title: VolumePill is four held bools plus closes_at; leave/Release events can be lost
trigger: Start dragging the live story volume slider, then the stream ends (slider slot set to None) or the viewer closes while the pointer is over the pill; reopen a live story.
effect: dragging/toggle/pill/keyboard are set by events on elements that can vanish before the matching leave or Release arrives (stream_volume_slider clears the slot, LiveStoryUi outlives the viewer). The pill then reads held() and stays open for the next live story.
fix: Reset volume_pill when the slider slot is cleared and when the story viewer is released, or derive 'held' from a single PillState enum.

title: dialing ticket is separate from the permission wait and stays Some on refusal
trigger: On macOS deny the microphone prompt when pressing Call.
effect: dial_user sets call_boxes.dialing before with_capture_access; only dial_allowed takes it. A refusal or a dropped continuation leaves it Some until the next dial or a switch. Two Call presses during one prompt share the single ticket, so the second silently does nothing.
fix: Put the ticket in the permission-ask enum (see with_device_access) so the refusal and the drop clear it.

title: Share Invite Link asks for the links and opens the box under the passcode lock
trigger: Lock Quill with a joined video chat (call windows stay usable), press Share in the call window menu or the invite row.
effect: group_call_needs_unlock only raises the main window and its result is ignored: the links request is sent and share_open is set while locked; the box appears at the unlock without being asked again. Other call-window openers refuse with refused_while_locked.
fix: Check refused_while_locked (or queue an unlock intent) in open_group_call_share_links before the request, and return when group_call_needs_unlock is true.

title: Sharing a call link to a chat overwrites a pending deep-link open
trigger: A deep link is waiting in links.pending_deep_link_open (for example queued while an earlier open is in progress), then the user picks a chat under Share to.
effect: The single Option slot is replaced; the earlier link action is lost without a note.
fix: Queue opens (Vec/VecDeque of PendingOpen) or refuse the share while one is pending.

title: In-call chat visibility and per-participant level animations outlive the call
trigger: Open the in-call chat (Show chat) in a video chat, leave, join another video chat. For levels: a participant sounds then leaves.
effect: chat_shown is never reset (only toggled and initialised), so the next call's window opens with the chat section already shown. row_levels entries are removed only when that row is built again, so a leaver's entry stays for the process and an audio_source_id reused by a later call starts from a stale animation.
fix: Move per-call UI into one CallView value created when a call is tracked and dropped when it ends (sync_group_call_boxes already knows the call id).

title: Stream Key stays revealed after the Settings box is left by Share or Leave, so the next Settings shows it without the warning
trigger: Manager opens the live stream window, Settings, Show key and accepts the warning (key_shown = true), then taps Share (line 294 sets overlay = None directly) or confirms Leave (line 491). Later reopens Settings in the same call.
effect: The RTMP stream key is drawn in clear without going through the KeyWarning box again; only close_stream_overlay and StreamWindow::clear reset key_shown.
fix: Make the key reveal part of the overlay enum (StreamOverlay::Settings { key_shown }) so every path that drops the overlay drops the reveal, instead of two fields reset by hand in two of the exits.

title: A stream join wish for a call that never gets tracked lingers and can join much later
trigger: Tap a stream link or the chat's video chat button (note_stream_join_intent records Call(id) with tracked_then = None); the call is never tracked (request fails or the user waits). Later, with no other call tracked, the same call is tracked from another entry (e.g. a link to the same call).
effect: consume_stream_join_intent finds the matching intent and joins immediately although the user only meant to look; the wish has no timeout or cancel except close_group_call_window and a different call being tracked.
fix: Give the Wanted stage a deadline (manual clock) or clear it when the request that fetches the call fails.

title: Blurred stream photo is kept after the chat loses its photo
trigger: During a live stream the channel photo is removed (chat_photo_path returns None).
effect: group_call_stream_photo returns at the first ? without clearing StreamWindow::photo, so the picture view keeps the old chat's blurred photo behind the label until the call ends.
fix: When the chat has no photo path, drop the cached photo (and its task) in the same place.

title: In-call composer text survives a change of call within the account
trigger: Type a message in call A's chat, leave A, join call B in the same account; the unsent text is still in the box and Send posts it to B
effect: A draft written for one call is sent to another; sync_group_call_boxes resets the rename box, invite, share and pin but not the composer
fix: Clear the composer in the same branch of sync_group_call_boxes that resets other per-call state (before != id).

title: A join intent noted before fetch_group_call is not cleared when the fetch fails
trigger: Press the voice chat button, fetch_group_call returns Err (note says could not reach); later join that same call another way
effect: stream_join stays set until a call is tracked, then the window auto-joins the stream the user gave up on
fix: Note the intent only after the send succeeded, or clear it in the Err arm.

title: Rename box is closed before the rename is sent, so a failed send loses the typed title
trigger: Open Rename voice chat, type a title, Save while set_video_chat_title returns Err or there is no live client
effect: Box closes with an error note; the typed title is gone and must be retyped
fix: Take the dialog out only on Ok; put it back on Err (as restrict/permissions boxes do).
